description: storage: getStorageStoresById's and createStorageStoresBlob's declared response schemas omit the store identity and configuration fields the live API returns (id, name, type, createdAt, updatedAt, billingState; the GET response additionally omits region, access, size, count, isTokenExpired). Live-verified 2026-08-13. The BlobStore reconciler observes name/access/region from GET and needs the id from the create response, so add them (id/name/type as required — always present on the wire). | storage: the three documented storage operations (createStorageStoresBlob, getStorageStoresById, deleteStorageStoresBlobById) omit the standard teamId/slug query parameters every other team-scoped operation declares. Team-scoped tokens infer the team, but the alchemy provider doctrine passes the resolved teamId on every call, so declare them.
